observation.command: echo "=== .pnpm sw-code placeholder has NO own files -> count own files ==="; for d in /workspace/app/node_modules/.pnpm/@sw-code+*; do n=$(find "$d/node_modules/@sw-code" -maxdepth 1 -type f 2>/dev/null | wc -l); echo "$(basename $d): own-files=$n"; done; echo "=== urbo package.json anywhere? ==="; find /workspace/app/node_modules -path "*urbo-core*package.json" 2>/dev/null | head; find /workspace -name "urbo-core" -type d 2>/dev/null | head
